items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: he did write some great arrangements for Sinatra.

ctx.x: But on the guitar it’s so hard, because you have the pick in your hand too, so you have to use your thumb instead and then try to write. So it’s kind of tough. But you get by on that. But Don Costa is the only one that I know of. I’ll have to ask some of the guitar players that I know, and he did write some great arrangements for Sinatra.
Have you ever had any physical ailments from years and years of that?
